title: Interstate banking deregulation on credit supply
research_question: Did state-level interstate banking deregulation increase credit supply (total loans / assets) in deregulated states compared to regulated states?
data_description: Panel data on 200 bank branches across 8 annual periods. Variables: unit_id, period, treated (1=state deregulated in period 4), post, treat_x_post, y (log loans-to-assets ratio). Deregulation timing varies across states — use the treated=1 group as those deregulating at period 4 exactly.
